body: SCOUT READ-ONLY FOLLOW-ON, exact current main e4bbf5b, disposable clone only; no reserved path touched. The public solve boundary has a second confirmed defect class beyond SinkhornConfig. Focused 2/2 diagnostic: cost=NaN and cost=-Inf both return Right(all-zero plan, 200, converged=false); a/b=NaN or -1 are silently treated like zero target mass and return Right with an ordinary-looking partial plan, converged=true; a/b=+Inf return Right(all-zero, 200, false). This means a config-only repair is necessary but not sufficient to make solve fail closed. Cost +Inf is different: it behaved as a forbidden edge and converged, so whether it is admitted should be an explicit contract decision rather than swept into a blanket finite check. Recommendation: keep current bead focused on the whole config boundary after the chief ownership ruling, and mint a separate same-path bead for marginal validation plus the cost NaN/-Inf policy. Probe output and exact cases are available; temp test is only in /private/tmp/storymodel4s-sinkhorn-probe-855b754.
